title: Address Amendment Charge — Billing Operations Calculation Sheet (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
## Basis

An address amendment reports to the ordering state the household's new mailing address on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate whose amendment rules require address amendments. An address amendment is charged the address-amendment rate, which is the certificate's amended filing fee as scheduled for the certificate held, and the address amendment charge is that rate booked to the cent.

The address amendment charge is the address-amendment vehicle charge plus the address-report lateness charge, the address-amendment reprint charge and the address notice-period check charge, the sum rounded to the cent, and it is booked once per address amendment, on its transmission.

## Calculation lines

| Line | Amount |
|---|---|
| A. Address-amendment rate | The certificate's amended filing fee |
| B. Address-amendment vehicle charge | Line A |
| C. Address-report lateness charge | 0.00 |
| D. Address-amendment reprint charge | 0.00 |
| E. Address notice-period check charge | 0.00 |
| Address amendment charge | B, C, D and E added together, rounded to the cent |

Rounding to the cent is applied to the total of lines B to E.

## Worked sheet (hypothetical figure)

Take, for this sheet only, a certificate whose amended filing fee is 12.00 (an invented figure; the actual fee is the one in the certificate's fee schedule).

- A: 12.00
- B: 12.00
- C, D, E: 0.00 each
- Address amendment charge: 12.00 plus 0.00 plus 0.00 plus 0.00, rounded to the cent: **12.00**, booked on the address amendment's transmission.

A household moving twice in a term has two address amendments and two charges, each on its own transmission.
